parityDifferences: The TypeScript index adds strict type-only re-exports for already-migrated declarations; runtime export names and order match the pinned source index.

The source index obtains AxialPileCapacityAnalysis through domain/geotechnics/index.js, while the TypeScript index obtains the already-migrated implementation from norms/geotechnics/AxialPileCapacityAnalysis.ts to preserve the repository's domain-to-norms dependency boundary without changing the public root API.
engineeringFunctionality: Source-compatible public composition for the method-neutral geotechnical deep-foundation application and its existing single-pile axial-capacity API. This slice does not add new geotechnical calculations or application functionality.
